title: A Space's badge note becomes a Check In button on the top right of its header image

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-22 in the project thread: move the Your badge works here strip to the top right of the header image; greyed out until the business activates badge check-in, an illuminated Check In button once it has.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. The Frequency Space header drops the strip under the tabs and draws a Check In button on the cover's top right (FqSpaceChrome coverAction). Activated = SCANNER_DEVICES_ENABLED, the Space's check in function on, and a live counter scanner (readCheckinActivated). Activated: the kit's .btn.pa opening the old strip's words in a dialog. Otherwise the same pill with aria-disabled and the disabled look. The DAWN branch keeps its strip. No new admin screen.

verify.note: Fails when the badge strip is back under the Space tabs or the cover has no Check In button.
